summary.text: Azalea Cormier is an unenrolled candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 80 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her campaign website says she is serving her second term on the Buckfield Select Board.

paragraphs.text: Cormier writes on her campaign website that she was born at Stephens Memorial in 1997 and raised in Western Maine by nurses, tradesmen and farmers.
She says she is serving her second term on Buckfield's Select Board.
Cormier's site describes her as an independent candidate with no party allegiance, and lists Buckfield, Hebron, Otisfield and Oxford as the communities of District 80.
She cites property taxes, home prices and the cost of food, utilities and health care as concerns driving her campaign.
